summary: Dine Brands Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, announcing that its Board declared a Q3 2026 cash dividend of $0.19 per share on common stock. The dividend is payable October 9, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 16, 2026. This is a routine quarterly dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a special dividend, buyback, or strategic event. The filing contains no deal terms or structural changes. It is an ordinary 'Other Events' item accompanied by a press release. No watch items apply; risk-arb or restructuring angles are absent.
